explanation: The application was flagged mainly because its SSN prefix is reused at about 3x the expected baseline (2.98x), and the address has 5 applications in the last 30 days. The same device was also used for 1 other application in the last 30 days, which adds to the concern. The email age, phone tenure, non-VoIP phone, name-email match, and credit history do not raise concern.
